Kund und zu wißen daß zwischen Sr. Durchlauch
dem regierenden Herrn Fürsten zu Hohenlohe Ingelfin
gen Gouverneur zu Breslau p. einerseits und dem Bau
Banco Rendant Herrn Leixner zu Frankfurth an der
Oder nachstehender Verkauf und Kauf-Contract
wohlbedächtig freywillig und unwiderruflich verab
redet geschloßen und vollzogen worden.
§. 1.
Es verkaufen nehmlich Sr. Hochfürstl. Durchlaucht der re¬
gierende Fürst zu Hohenlohe Ingelfingen Gouverneur
zu Breslau p. Höchst Ihre unter dem Departement
der Regierung zu Posen in dem
Kreiße gelegene Güther
Kollno und Kamionne
mit sämmtlichen dazu gehörigen Attinenzien und Müh¬
len, Rechten und Gerechtigkeiten, mit allen Einsaßen,
Feldern, Waldungen, Seen und Gewäßern mit den
Zinsen und der Propination, den Diensten der Jagd
und der Jurisdiction auch allen übrigen Rechten
und Zubehör, so wie Höchst Sr. Durchl. gedachte Gu¬
ther und deren Attinenzien zufolge der Donations
Urkunde wovon dem Herrn Käufer eine vidimirte
Abschrift eingehändigt werden soll, und für deren
Richtigkeit und Wahrheit Sr. Durchlaucht in Anse¬
hung der Güther Kollno und Kamionne die Eviction
leisten, von der Königl. Commission tradirt er¬
halten, beseßen und genutzt, auch nutzen und ge¬
nießen können, mit Allem wie es steht und liegt
endlich auch mit allem Sr. Durchlaucht wider die
Innseßen und Unterthanen dieser Güther etwa zu
stehenden Rechte und Gerechtigkeiten welche sie sich
angemaaßet haben, und zu praetendiren glauben, Sr.
Wohlgebl. dem Königl. Banco Rendanten Herrn George
Conrad Leixner in Frankfurth an der Oder vor ein
bestimmte Kauf-Summe von Einmahlshundert
zwey und Vierzig Tausend Reichsthaler Königl. Preußl.
64ge Curant zu seinem völligen Eigenthum.
§. 2.
Der heutige Kauf über die Güther Kollno und Kam¬
ionne geschieht ohne Anschlag, in Pausch und Bogen
deswegen leisten Sr. Hochfürstl. Durchl. blos in An¬
sehung des von der Königl. Commission aufgenom¬
menen Vermeßungs-Registers und der in der Tan¬
aufgeführten Realitäten welche bey der Tradition
übergeben werden sollen eine Eviction Alle Ein¬
künfte und Wirthschafts, Erträge, muß Herr Käu¬
fer so übernehmen, wie sie existiren, und je
nach dem sie sich in der Folge erhöhen, oder ver¬
mindern können, welches sich Herr Häufer auch
gefallen laßt.
Sr. Hochfürstl. Durchlaucht haben mit dem Herr
Rittmeister von Broniewsky am 3. Julij a. c. eine
Vergleich schließen laßen, noch deßen Innhalt der
selbe die Güther Kollno und Kamionne gegen
Empfangnahme einer Summe von 53139. Rthl.
13. Ggl. 8 4/5 Pfl. so fort zurück zu geben, und die
ther an Höchstdieselben zurück gewähren will.
Da nun der Kaufmann Herr Simon als Bevoll¬
mächtigter des Herrn Leixner mit dem Herr
von Broniewsky am 6. huj in Posen dahin übereingekommen
daß die Zahlung der 53139. Rthl. 13. Gg. 8 4/5. Pf. den 8. Sept. be¬
in Posen erfolgen, die Natural - Tradition der Guthe
aber den 10. Sept. in Kollno und Kamionne geschehen
soll, so versprechen Sr. Durchl. zu gedachter Zeit
einen Bevollmächtigten nach Posen und Kollno un¬
Kamionne zu schicken, um bey diesen Actibus
zugegen zu seyn, und da ein Regierungs Commissa¬
rius von Posen die Natural - Uebergabe vollzie¬
hen wird, so stipuliren Sr. Durchl. die Güther
Kollno und Kamionne unmittelbar am 10ten
Sept dem Herrn Käufer tradiren zu laßen.
§. 4.
Sowohl in dem Vergleiche vom 3 July als auch in
einer spätern Declaration des Herrn von Bro¬
niewsky hat sich derselbe verbindlich gemacht, alle
seine Intabulata auf Kollno und Kamionne
völlig lösen, und dadurch diese Güther von alle
darauf für ihn gehafteten Nexibus depuniren
zu laßen. Herr Käufer erhält daher diese Gü¬
ther ganz schuldenfrey.
§. 5.
Herr von Broniewsky behält alle Mutzungen den
Güther bis zum 24. Juny a. c. Von diesem Tage an
gehen alle Nutzungen und Beschwerden auf de
Herrn Käufer über, und wird Herr von Bro¬
niewsky, bey der Natural-Uebergabe die diesfällige
Rechnung legen, so wie er auch zugleich den Beilassen
an Feld- Vieh- und Wirthschafts-Inventarium
welches der von Broniewsky bey Uebernahme
der Güther Anno 1786. als Herrschaftlichen
Beilass erhalten, so wie es die damalige Traditione Acte
besagt zurück gewähren wird. Ein Mehreres hat Herr
Käufer um so weniger zu erhalten, als Sr. Hochfürstl.
Durchl. sich bis jetzt noch nicht, in dem Natural- Besitz
der Güther befunden, und HochEdieselben daher auch
nicht mehr überliefern können, als was Höchst Pries
jezt erst tradirt wird.
§. 6.
Dem Herrn Verkäufer Durchlaucht sind keine Servitié
ten bekannt, welche die Güther Kollno und Kamun
ne leidend betreffen. Dagegen steht diesen Gü¬
theen der freye Hieb als an demselben gebühren
des Recht, in den Forsten zu Gory und Krobilaw
zu, welcher Hieb auch durch ein neuerliches Pos.
sessorium - Erkenntniß festgesetzt worden. Dem
5) eere Käufer steht daher dieses Recht ebenfalls
zu, und hat derselbe den weitern Proceß darü¬
ber fort zu setzen in so fern der von Kwilecki
solchen nach weiter treiben sollte. Das Posses
sorium- Urtel ist dem Herrn Käufer auch be¬
reits eingehendigt worden, und läßt sich der¬
selbe die Erklärung Dr. Durchl. gefallen.
§. 7.
Alle Documente und Schriften welche diese Güther
betreffen, und die des Herrn Verkäufers Durchl.
oder Hochst. Jhre Bevollmächtigte noch in Händen
haben sollen dem Herrn Bäufer traulich extra¬
dirt werden.
§. 8.
Sr. Durchlaucht haben den Justiz Bürgermeister
Metzig in Schwerin als Justitiarius in Betsch Kollno
und Kamionne angenommen. Dieser wird von allen
was die Justiz und deren Acta betrift Auskunft
geben, so wie er auch das Deposital- Wesen unter
sich hat. Es hängt von dem Herrn Käufer ab, ihn bey¬
zu behalten, oder einen andern anzunehmen. Sr.
Durchl. bezahlen dem p. Metzig das Salarium bis
Michaelis a. c. womit Herr Käufer auch zufrieden
ist.
§. 9.
Sr. Majestaet der König haben dem Herrn Käufer
bereits im Monath July a. c. die Allenhöchste Concession
zum Ankauf dieser Güther ertheilet, so daß also gegen
deßen Besitzfähigkeit nichts zu erinnern ist, und da die
ser Punckt auf Kosten des Herrn Käufers geht, so
behalt es dabey sein bewenden.
§. 10.
Die Absicht des Herrn Käufers geht dahin die Güther Koll
no und Kamionne zu dismembriren. Sr. Durchl.
wollen diesem Geschäfte keine Hinderniße in den
Weg legen, sondern sie genehmigen es auch beför¬
dern, daß sie auf Rechnung des Herrn Käufers
vollzogen werde. Wie Hochsdieselben auch schon
den Consens dazu bey dem Cameral-Departement
haben nach suchen laßen. Etwas weiteres zu thun
liegt außer den Kräften Sr. Durchl. und ist es
daher blos des Herrn Käufers Sache diese Ange¬
legenheit zu betreiben und zu Ende zu bringen
§. 11.
Was nun die Bezahlung der stipulirten Kauf¬
Gelder betrift, so ist unter den Contrahenten fol¬
gendes bestimmt und festgesetzt worden.
Herr Käufer übernimmt noch stehende Onera per¬
petua
a., einen Jährlichen Zins von Vier Marck Pohlnisch
von dem Guthe Kamionne an die dasigen
Kirche von einem Capital von Einhundert
Gulden Pohlnisch
b., ein Capital von 250 Rthl oder Ein tausend fünf
hundert Gulden Pohlnisch welches als ein für die
Kirche zu Kamionne auf dem Marckt-Flecken
zu Kollno haftendes a 3 1/2. proCent Zinsen in
tabulirtes Capital radiciret, jedoch letzteres
mit dem Beisatz, daß wenn die rückständi¬
gen Zinßen ad alterum tantum gefordert
durch Urtel und Recht festgesetzt werden soll
ten des Herrn Verkaufers Durchl. diese Zin¬

translation.en:
Be it known and understood that between His Serene Highness the reigning Prince zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, Governor of Breslau etc., on the one part, and the Building-Bank Rendant Herr Leixner of Frankfurth an der Oder, the following contract of sale and purchase has been, after due deliberation, freely and irrevocably agreed, concluded and executed.

§. 1. Namely, His Most Serene Highness the reigning Prince zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, Governor of Breslau etc., sells His own estates situated under the Department of the Government at Posen in the [text lost] District,

Kollno and Kamionne, with all appurtenances and mills belonging thereto, rights and privileges, with all inhabitants, fields, forests, lakes and waters, with the rents and the propination rights, the services, the hunt and the jurisdiction, also all remaining rights and appurtenances, just as His Serene Highness received the said estates and their appurtenances delivered over from the Royal Commission by virtue of the instrument of donation, of which a vidimated Copy is to be handed to the Herr Purchaser, and for whose correctness and truth His Serene Highness furnishes eviction-warranty in respect of the estates Kollno and Kamionne, and has possessed and enjoyed them, and can also use and enjoy them, with everything as it stands and lies, and finally also with all rights and privileges that may pertain to His Serene Highness against the

residents and subjects of these estates, which [rights] they have arrogated to themselves and believe themselves entitled to claim, — to His Honour the Royal Banco-Rendant Herr George Conrad Leixner in Frankfurth an der Oder, for a fixed purchase sum of One Hundred and Forty-Two Thousand Reichsthaler Royal Prussian 64-piece Courant, as his complete property.

§. 2. This day's purchase of the estates Kollno and Kamionne is made without valuation, in Pausch und Bogen; for that reason His Most Serene Highness furnishes eviction-warranty solely in respect of the survey register taken up by the Royal Commission and of the real assets listed in the [uncertain: Tan], which are to be handed over at the delivery. All revenues and farming yields the Herr Purchaser must take over as they exist, and according as they may hereafter increase or diminish, with which the Herr Purchaser likewise declares himself content.

His Most Serene Highness has caused a settlement to be concluded with Herr Rittmeister von Broniewsky on the 3rd of July of the current year, according to the content of which the same is willing, upon receipt of a sum of 53139 Rthl. 13 Ggl. 8 4/5 Pfl., to give back the estates Kollno and Kamionne forthwith and to restore the [estates] to His Highness. Now since the merchant Herr Simon, as authorised representative of Herr Leixner, has with Herr

von Broniewsky agreed at Posen on the 6th of this month that payment of the 53139 Rthl. 13 Gg. 8 4/5 Pf. shall be made on the 8th of September at Posen, but the natural delivery of the estates shall take place on the 10th of September at Kollno and Kamionne, His Serene Highness accordingly promises to send an authorised representative to Posen and to Kollno and Kamionne at the said time, in order to be present at these Actibus; and since a Government Commissary from Posen will carry out the natural handing-over, His Serene Highness stipulates that the estates Kollno and Kamionne be delivered directly to the Herr Purchaser on the 10th of September.

§. 4. Both in the settlement of the 3rd of July and also in a later declaration Herr von Broniewsky has bound himself to redeem entirely all his Intabulata upon Kollno and Kamionne, and thereby to have these estates cleared of all Nexibus charged upon them on his account. The Herr Purchaser therefore receives these estates wholly free of debt.

§. 5. Herr von Broniewsky retains all usufructs of the estates until the 24th of June of the current year. From that day onward all usufructs and burdens pass over to the Herr Purchaser, and Herr von Broniewsky will render the account thereof at the natural handing-over, just as he will at the same time restore the Beilass in field, cattle and farming inventory which the said von Broniewsky received in the year 1786 upon taking over the estates as manorial

Beilass, as the deed of delivery of that time states. The Herr Purchaser has all the less to receive anything further, inasmuch as His Most Serene Highness has hitherto not yet been in natural possession of the estates, and therefore also cannot hand over more than what is only now being delivered to His Highness.

§. 6. To the Herr Seller's Serene Highness no servitudes are known which burden the estates Kollno and Kamionne passively. On the other hand, there belongs to these estates the free right of felling, as a right due to the same, in the forests at Gory and Krobilaw, which right of felling has also been established by a recent judgment in Possessorium. The

5) Herr Purchaser is therefore likewise entitled to this right, and he is to carry on the further process concerning it, in so far as von Kwilecki should pursue the same further. The judgment in Possessorium has also already been handed to the Herr [uncertain: Schufer], and he declares himself content with the declaration of His Serene Highness.

§. 7. All documents and writings which concern these estates, and which the Herr Seller's Serene Highness or His authorised representatives may still have in hand, shall be faithfully extradited to the Herr Purchaser.

§. 8. His Serene Highness has engaged the justice-burgomaster

Metzig at Schwerin as Justitiarius in Betsch, Kollno and Kamionne. He will give information on all that concerns the administration of justice and its records, just as he also has the deposit business under his charge. It rests with the Herr Purchaser to retain him or to engage another. His Serene Highness pays the said Metzig his salary until Michaelmas of the current year, with which the Herr Purchaser is likewise content.

§. 9. His Majesty the King has already in the month of July of the current year granted the Herr Purchaser the All-Highest concession to purchase these estates, so that there is nothing to be objected against his capacity to possess; and since this point goes at the Herr Purchaser's expense, the matter rests thereupon.

§. 10. The Herr Purchaser's intention is to dismember the estates Kollno and Kamionne. His Serene Highness will lay no obstacles in the way of this business, but rather approves it and will also further it, that it be carried out on the Herr Purchaser's account; as His Highness has also already caused the consent thereto to be applied for at the Cameral Department. To do anything further lies beyond the powers of His Serene Highness, and it is therefore solely the Herr Purchaser's affair to pursue this matter and bring it to a conclusion.

§. 11. As regards now the payment of the stipulated purchase moneys, the following has been determined and settled among the contracting parties.

The Herr Purchaser takes over the following standing Onera perpetua:

a., an annual rent of Four Polish Marks from the estate Kamionne to the church there, from a capital of One Hundred Polish Gulden;

b., a capital of 250 Rthl, or One Thousand Five Hundred Polish Gulden, which is radicated as a capital intabulated at 3 1/2 per cent interest and charged upon the market-town of Kollno for the benefit of the church at Kamionne; the latter, however, with the addition that if the arrears of interest, demanded ad ulterum tantum, should be established by judgment and law, the Herr Seller's Serene Highness will settle this interest together with costs up to St. John's Day of the current year.

c., in public taxes for Kamionne annually

153 Rth. 22 ggl. 8 Pf.

likewise for Kollno annually

125 Rthl. 21 ggl. 2 Pf.; further, in ecclesiastical dues in

Kamionne

16 Rthl. 16 ggl., which the Herr Purchaser promises to pay and discharge annually.

Further, the Herr Purchaser has paid upon the stipulated purchase price of the 142000 Rthl:

d., at the term of St. John's Day of the current year, a sum of Seventy-Six Thousand Reichsthaler Courant into the hands of Herr Berg-Rath Bernhardi, to whom His Serene Highness was pleased to make the order to pay. His Serene Highness acknowledges receipt of this sum, and is content that this receipt may be produced for the purpose of cancelling the capital of One Hundred Thousand

text_english:
Be it known and understood that between His Serene Highness the reigning Prince zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, Governor of Breslau etc., on the one part, and the Building-Bank Rendant Herr Leixner of Frankfurth an der Oder, the following contract of sale and purchase has been, after due deliberation, freely and irrevocably agreed, concluded and executed.

§. 1. Namely, His Most Serene Highness the reigning Prince zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, Governor of Breslau etc., sells His own estates situated under the Department of the Government at Posen in the [text lost] District,

Kollno and Kamionne, with all appurtenances and mills belonging thereto, rights and privileges, with all inhabitants, fields, forests, lakes and waters, with the rents and the propination rights, the services, the hunt and the jurisdiction, also all remaining rights and appurtenances, just as His Serene Highness received the said estates and their appurtenances delivered over from the Royal Commission by virtue of the instrument of donation, of which a vidimated Copy is to be handed to the Herr Purchaser, and for whose correctness and truth His Serene Highness furnishes eviction-warranty in respect of the estates Kollno and Kamionne, and has possessed and enjoyed them, and can also use and enjoy them, with everything as it stands and lies, and finally also with all rights and privileges that may pertain to His Serene Highness against the

residents and subjects of these estates, which [rights] they have arrogated to themselves and believe themselves entitled to claim, — to His Honour the Royal Banco-Rendant Herr George Conrad Leixner in Frankfurth an der Oder, for a fixed purchase sum of One Hundred and Forty-Two Thousand Reichsthaler Royal Prussian 64-piece Courant, as his complete property.

§. 2. This day's purchase of the estates Kollno and Kamionne is made without valuation, in Pausch und Bogen; for that reason His Most Serene Highness furnishes eviction-warranty solely in respect of the survey register taken up by the Royal Commission and of the real assets listed in the [uncertain: Tan], which are to be handed over at the delivery. All revenues and farming yields the Herr Purchaser must take over as they exist, and according as they may hereafter increase or diminish, with which the Herr Purchaser likewise declares himself content.

His Most Serene Highness has caused a settlement to be concluded with Herr Rittmeister von Broniewsky on the 3rd of July of the current year, according to the content of which the same is willing, upon receipt of a sum of 53139 Rthl. 13 Ggl. 8 4/5 Pfl., to give back the estates Kollno and Kamionne forthwith and to restore the [estates] to His Highness. Now since the merchant Herr Simon, as authorised representative of Herr Leixner, has with Herr

von Broniewsky agreed at Posen on the 6th of this month that payment of the 53139 Rthl. 13 Gg. 8 4/5 Pf. shall be made on the 8th of September at Posen, but the natural delivery of the estates shall take place on the 10th of September at Kollno and Kamionne, His Serene Highness accordingly promises to send an authorised representative to Posen and to Kollno and Kamionne at the said time, in order to be present at these Actibus; and since a Government Commissary from Posen will carry out the natural handing-over, His Serene Highness stipulates that the estates Kollno and Kamionne be delivered directly to the Herr Purchaser on the 10th of September.

§. 4. Both in the settlement of the 3rd of July and also in a later declaration Herr von Broniewsky has bound himself to redeem entirely all his Intabulata upon Kollno and Kamionne, and thereby to have these estates cleared of all Nexibus charged upon them on his account. The Herr Purchaser therefore receives these estates wholly free of debt.

§. 5. Herr von Broniewsky retains all usufructs of the estates until the 24th of June of the current year. From that day onward all usufructs and burdens pass over to the Herr Purchaser, and Herr von Broniewsky will render the account thereof at the natural handing-over, just as he will at the same time restore the Beilass in field, cattle and farming inventory which the said von Broniewsky received in the year 1786 upon taking over the estates as manorial

Beilass, as the deed of delivery of that time states. The Herr Purchaser has all the less to receive anything further, inasmuch as His Most Serene Highness has hitherto not yet been in natural possession of the estates, and therefore also cannot hand over more than what is only now being delivered to His Highness.

§. 6. To the Herr Seller's Serene Highness no servitudes are known which burden the estates Kollno and Kamionne passively. On the other hand, there belongs to these estates the free right of felling, as a right due to the same, in the forests at Gory and Krobilaw, which right of felling has also been established by a recent judgment in Possessorium. 5) Herr Purchaser is therefore likewise entitled to this right, and he is to carry on the further process concerning it, in so far as von Kwilecki should pursue the same further. The judgment in Possessorium has also already been handed to the Herr [uncertain: Schufer], and he declares himself content with the declaration of His Serene Highness.

§. 7. All documents and writings which concern these estates, and which the Herr Seller's Serene Highness or His authorised representatives may still have in hand, shall be faithfully extradited to the Herr Purchaser.

§. 8. His Serene Highness has engaged the justice-burgomaster

Metzig at Schwerin as Justitiarius in Betsch, Kollno and Kamionne. He will give information on all that concerns the administration of justice and its records, just as he also has the deposit business under his charge. It rests with the Herr Purchaser to retain him or to engage another. His Serene Highness pays the said Metzig his salary until Michaelmas of the current year, with which the Herr Purchaser is likewise content.

His Serene Highness will lay no obstacles in the way of this business, but rather approves it and will also further it, that it be carried out on the Herr Purchaser's account; as His Highness has also already caused the consent thereto to be applied for at the Cameral Department. To do anything further lies beyond the powers of His Serene Highness, and it is therefore solely the Herr Purchaser's affair to pursue this matter and bring it to a conclusion.

summary_en: Contract of sale by which Friedrich Ludwig, Fürst zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, Governor of Breslau, conveys the donated estates Kollno and Kamionne, with mills, propination, hunt and jurisdiction, to Banco-Rendant George Conrad Leixner of Frankfurth an der Oder for 142,000 Rthl in Pausch und Bogen: 76,000 already paid to Berg-Rath Bernhardi, 53,139 Rthl 13 Gg 8 4/5 Pf to Rittmeister von Broniewsky at Posen, 12,860 Rthl at delivery. Terms cover the Gory and Krobilaw felling right, church rents and taxes, Justitiarius Metzig, royal concession and Leixner's intended dismemberment.
summary_de: Kaufvertrag über die Güter Kollno und Kamionne im Departement der Regierung zu Posen: Friedrich Ludwig, Fürst zu Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, verkauft sie in Pausch und Bogen mit Mühlen, Propinations-, Jagd- und Gerichtsrechten an den Bau-Banco-Rendanten George Conrad Leixner in Frankfurth an der Oder für 142000 Rthl Courant; Zahlung mit 76000 Rthl an Berg-Rath Bernhardi, 53139 Rthl 13 Ggl 8 4/5 Pf an Rittmeister von Broniewsky und 12860 Rthl 10 Ggl 3 1/5 Pf bei der Übergabe. Geregelt werden Onera perpetua, Kirchenzinsen, das Holzungsrecht in Gory und Krobilaw, der Justitiarius Metzig sowie die beabsichtigte Dismembration.
